prompt: 2,2-dimethyloxirane + CH3MgBr; then H3O+. Draw the alcohol product.

answers.label: 2-methyl-2-butanol (Me added to the LESS hindered CH2 end, OH on the tert-C)

traps.note: Grignard is a strong, bulky Nu — attacks the LESS substituted epoxide C (SN2-like under basic conditions).

explanation: Under basic conditions (Grignard), the Nu attacks the LESS hindered epoxide C in SN2 fashion. The methyl adds to the CH2 side, leaving the alkoxide on the gem-dimethyl C (3°). Workup → 2-methyl-2-butanol.
